notes: Fixes real bugs from live testing: 3D-then-back-to-2D was silently breaking 2D zoom and rendering, the minimap drag had a timing race, trackpad zoom was wildly oversensitive, the mindmap 'updates/min' tooltip froze while hovering, and the Settings dialog's width override never actually applied. Packages (the city package) now arrive collapsed as one card you extend to see the pieces inside.
